claim_summaries: Reconstructed the heat-seed iid-product mixture and Duhamel double-commutator proof of a parameter-dependent fully separable approximation with explicit finite-N trace-distance certificate O_(M,B)(N^-3/2), for fixed public M,B and t0>0.
Independently derived the weighted scalar-prior Laplace remainder O_(M,B)(N^-1/2); it is subdominant to the distinct universal product decoder error O_(M,B)(N^-1/4).

Finite-bit product preparation is a mathematical rational-input construction with charged interval/random-bit/native-qubit costs, not an executed implementation or hardware result; operational rates are not proved optimal.
status: initial reconstruction complete; proof candidate remains internally audited only; deeper independent attack continues
